acceptanceCriteria: Given a registered customer is on the login page and selects “Forgot password,” when they enter the email address linked to their account, then the system sends a one-time password-reset link to that email address.

Given the customer opens a valid, unexpired reset link, when they enter a new password that meets the password policy and confirms it, then the system updates the password, signs out all active sessions, and displays a success confirmation

Given the customer uses an expired, already-used, or invalid reset link, when they attempt to reset their password, then the system displays a clear error message and provides an option to request a new reset link
